note: Every assembled word of the file has one owner. Every instruction word but one was started, and every interpretive word was read by the interpreter, in the unchanged original program in Virtual AGC under at least one case of the Lane C extended-verb suites (oracle LANEC_TRACE), and the native modules reproduce those cases' complete results (2048 erasable words, registers, channels, superbank, interrupt state). Call arguments are compiled into the native call. Constants are compiled from symbols.txt WORD rows or as literals where native code reads them. Every labelled entry and every return into the file from a callee is a transfer-ABI routine (abi_routine; tools/lanec/routines.py ev checks this against the listing). The one unreachable word is listed with the reason, checked against the listing.
